item.title: Relay a surprise cancellation to a walking group
item.context_text: You are helping a group of six organise a guided walk. One member is already on the bus.
item.objective_text: Keep the group together and share an accessible alternative with clear next steps.
success_conditions: Keep the group together and share an accessible alternative with clear next steps.

children.title: Read the walk notice
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Normal start: bridge gate at eleven. If the river path closes, meet at the town museum. Admission there is free with the walk ticket. The museum has a lift.

questions.prompt: Where does a normal walk start?
questions.explanation: The normal meeting point is the bridge gate.

questions.prompt: How can a walker enter the museum for free?
questions.explanation: The walk ticket covers museum admission.

children.title: Hear the tour guide
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: The river path is closed this morning. The guide can meet people at the museum at eleven thirty. We won't know about tomorrow’s walk until the river is checked at nine. Keep your ticket today.

questions.prompt: When will the group meet the guide today?
questions.explanation: The guide gives a delayed time at the museum.

options: Whether tomorrow’s walk will go ahead
Whether the museum is open today
questions.explanation: The path will be reassessed at nine tomorrow.

children.title: Call the member already travelling
children.prompt_text: The walker says their bus stops by the bridge, and they are worried about missing the new group.
children.instructions: Correct the place and time and reassure them with one useful ticket detail.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Please get off in town and go to the museum instead of the bridge gate. We meet the guide at eleven thirty. Your walk ticket gets you in for free.

children.title: Post the group message
children.prompt_text: One member uses stairs with difficulty. Another asks whether to wait for tomorrow instead.
children.instructions: Give the confirmed plan for today and tell the group what remains uncertain for tomorrow. Include useful details without guessing at the path condition.
children.goal: Keep the group together and share an accessible alternative with clear next steps.
children.model_answer: Today's river walk is cancelled because the path is closed. Meet at the town museum at eleven thirty. The museum has a lift and accepts your walk ticket for free admission. Please keep the ticket. Tomorrow’s walk is still uncertain until the river is checked at nine, so wait for the next update.
